subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata contract, or keep Slack on placeholders/media paths plus download-file?
rationale: The useful fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin contract, and repository guidance treats that as a shared boundary decision rather than a Slack-only implementation detail.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a narrow InboundAttachments-style context shape and populate it from Slack first while keeping existing media fields compatible.

options.title: Add Slack-only metadata
options.body: Expose only Slack file ids or text-enriched placeholders faster, accepting cross-channel drift and a likely later migration.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Rely on placeholders, MediaPaths, docs, and download-file without adding a new agent metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow InboundAttachments-style context shape and populate it from Slack first while keeping existing media fields compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack media merges and adjacent channel-boundary work make this the strongest available routing candidate.
